sidebarTitle: "compareinstances"

keywords: ["compareinstances","Cache"]
---

<div className="real-function-page">

```lua
compareinstances(first: Instance, second: Instance): boolean
```

## Arguments

<ParamField path={"first"} type={"Instance"} required>
Premier Instance object a comparer.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path={"second"} type={"Instance"} required>
Deuxieme Instance object a comparer.
</ParamField>

## Retours

<ResponseField name={"equal"} type={"boolean"}>
True lorsque les deux valeurs Instance object contiennent la meme valeur interne de pointeur.
</ResponseField>

## Exemple

Compare les valeurs internes du pointeur Instance stockees dans deux valeurs Instance object.

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

print(compareinstances(Players, Players))
print(compareinstances(Players, ReplicatedStorage))
```
